subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this be tracked as a distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` recovery/UI-history issue, or folded into the existing ambiguous-delivery and guarded-lane recovery work?
rationale: The source evidence supports the shared `send_attempt_started` recovery gap, but the report also adds a reasoning-preview trigger and `chat.history` pressure that existing linked work may not cover.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery path and any Control UI history burst while cross-linking the delivery-recovery PRs.

options.title: Fold Into Delivery Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history symptoms as incidental, and track the remaining fix through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87552.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate canonical item for the `chat.history` latency burst if maintainers want separate ownership.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery path and any Control UI history burst while cross-linking the delivery-recovery PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared outbound recovery semantics and Telegram delivery safety, and the history sample points to steipete as the strongest shared-boundary owner.
